name: subprocess-local
description: The subprocess@1 provider `local-process`: bounded LOCAL command execution on the workbench host - argv based (no shell unless asked), streamed output with an inline cap, a deadline that kills the whole process GROUP, and the overflow handed to spill@1. Declares execution/policies because it starts host processes.

config.description: The default working directory, the deadline and output caps, the shell policy and the spill handoff of every call.

cwd.description: Working directory used when a call names none (default: the process cwd).

timeoutMs.description: Default deadline in ms (hard max 600000). On expiry the whole process group is signalled.

maxOutputBytes.description: Default inline byte cap of stdout/stderr (hard max 1048576).

overflowBytes.description: Bytes kept BEYOND the cap so the overflow can be spilled instead of lost.

graceMs.description: Grace between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when a deadline expires.

allowShell.description: Whether `shell: true` (the explicit shell escape hatch) is allowed at all. false makes every string command a structured error.

spillLabel.description: Default label of the spill file name for capped output.

spill.description: Hand output beyond the cap to spill@1 (false keeps the truncated inline answer).

env.description: Environment entries every call inherits (values are never logged).

sandbox.description: EXTENSION POINT: an optional sandbox policy handle; when a sandbox@1 provider is loaded its `checkCommand` runs before any process is started. Never a dependency.
